title: ANR Types, StrictMode, and Diagnosis Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies anr types, strictmode, and diagnosis?
options: Classify the ANR, reconstruct the causal thread dependency and remove blocking from the responsiveness path.
questions.answer: Classify the ANR, reconstruct the causal thread dependency and remove blocking from the responsiveness path.
questions.explanation: This answer preserves the underlying platform or delivery contract while requiring representative evidence, explicit failure behaviour, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: Every ANR report whose main stack shows nativePollOnce proves the main thread was healthy throughout the event.
questions.explanation: Moving disk work to a coroutine and calling runBlocking on the main thread preserves the blocking dependency and can still trigger the same ANR.

questions.prompt: Why inspect other threads for an ANR?
questions.answer: The main thread may be waiting on a lock, binder or worker whose stack reveals the actual causal dependency.
questions.explanation: The response identifies the mechanism that makes the decision reliable instead of relying on a convenient proxy.
